scope: Conditional clock gates for fully recovered task0 staff reconsidering work; earlier checkout/refill choices must fail before cleaning is tried.
index_convention: n=0..149, clock=2*n+parity; these are phase positions, not elapsed times since rest/full recovery.
wrap_scope: No uint32 overflow within block; retain saved clock phase and parity in native implementation.
limitations: No task success rate, probability or real seconds is inferred.
Target availability, fatigue/recovery, earlier tasks, path and fixture conditions remain required.
This package establishes the original cleaning time gate; it does not newly establish the checkout helper internal time gate.
Odd parity is a conditional case, not a claim about the default new-game clock.
